_comment: Locale registry for Kwik Fat Cut. Adding a locale means adding an entry here and a matching folder under i18n/. No JavaScript changes required.
_default_comment: Every visitor sees the default locale until they pick another one in the switcher, or open a link with ?lang=es (or en-US). Their pick is remembered across pages. Set detect to true only if you want the site to guess a language from the visitor's timezone and browser language.

es.label: Español
es.untranslated: Esta página todavía no está disponible en español. El menú y el pie de página sí lo están. Estamos traduciendo el sitio por partes.

_regions_comment: Only used when detect is true. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country to locale. Anything not listed falls through to the language check, then to the default locale.
_languages_comment: Only used when detect is true. navigator.language prefix to locale, used when the region is unknown.
